findings.problem: Inconsistent verb stem within schnauben card.
findings.reason: Infinitiv uses At hvæse (snort/puff) but preterite uses fnøs from fnyse (sneeze). schnauben needs one consistent Danish lemma across all forms.

findings.problem: Inconsistent verb stem within schnauben card.
findings.reason: Konjunktiv II uses fnyse while infinitiv is At hvæse. Learners cannot reconcile mixed lemmas for one German verb.
Fnyst is not a valid Danish participle. Standard forms are Fnyset (fnyse) or, aligned with card infinitiv At hvæse, Hvæset.
Han fnyser means 'he sneezes', not snort/puff. Infinitiv At hvæse is semantically correct for schnauben; present should be Han hvæser.
